output.reason: The release note [ev-40a85034a6bd] is only a title, but the linked PR fills in the details. It says the change lets project roles display and add resources other than `applications`, namely `applicationsets` and the other project-scoped resources (clusters, repositories, etc.), in the UI [ev-6362629082d5][ev-0d8df95b21b5]. It also says the project-scoped resource map moved from `rbacpolicies` into the `rbac` package to avoid circular dependencies, which is why so many files changed [ev-0d8df95b21b5][ev-cdfa6f2b485b]. That is enough to write the assertion: the subject is project-role RBAC for project-scoped resources, the change is added support, and an operator who does nothing simply gets the new capability, with no breakage described. The changed-files list includes RBAC-related server files whose behaviour the PR text does not describe beyond the move, so some doubt remains.
